title: C: CCA IRQ and TX execution without RX preemption
description:
Extend lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_tx.c and lora_l2_rx.c so CAD/CSMA, modem leases, cancellation, TX completion and RX rearm respect committed receive intervals. Recheck remaining complete-operation fit and legal/adaptive restrictions after every bounded wait and before emission. Busy, reset, configuration failure or late IRQ must not lead to unauthorized TX, unaccounted emitted airtime or an SF fallback.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse b7z9.29's existing CAD/CSMA mechanics and the existing IRQ lifecycle, not a new driver framework. zephyr.05 owns full geometry while zephyr.06 supplies only the reused minimum; zephyr.10/.11 own accounting restrictions. Old roll-ups and downstream admission tests are not prerequisites. Preserve bounded queues, custody policy, radio-owned identity, baseline SCHC/security and deferred portability; no OSCORE/EDHOC edits.
acceptance_criteria: Drive the actual L2/driver boundary with independent vectors.04/.06/.08 event traces. Cover queued TX during RX, busy/clear/error/timeout CAD, modem lock delay, cancellation, reset, late/duplicate completion and RX rearm failure. Assert no transmit after consumed slack or lost grant/budget and no RX cancellation that violates a commitment. Extend lichen/tests/csma, HAL tests and TDMA-enabled lichen/tests/ping_l2 on local Linux/heft native_sim with the verified west pin. Run sanitizers and scoped C lint; no hardware access.
